## Requirements (contract § In scope — deliverables)

1. RQ-00 (K11): unique task ids and no dead anchors; disposition list from the
   catalog vocabulary instead of `[]`; "not yet classified" instead of
   `contributor`/`unknown` placeholders.
2. Retire fixtures (QW-10; F-113, F-274): the `/task/new/` fixture pages and
   the "has been generated" copy; a "how to help" paragraph only as confirmed
   copy (none exists → none is added).
3. Labels (C3 NEW-13): page-specific provenance labels on the queue.
4. Copy: every new public sentence drafted into copy batch #1
   (`docs/build/reports/copy-batches/batch-01.md`: page, text, sha256, status);
   a check fails when a changed page carries an untracked sentence.

Out of scope: publication (P34.17's L2 republish); the W1–W4 real queue
surfaces (RQ-01…05, K13 §7.1); capstone journeys (P37.63–64/CAP-01).

## Plan

1. `web/src/lib/research-queue.ts`: `NOT_YET_CLASSIFIED` honest label; the card
   gains an optional `task_id` (additive — prior exports without it keep
   parsing; the anchor then derives from the `(task_type, subject_id)` dedup
   key); `taskAnchor`/`assertUniqueTaskAnchors`/`jurisdictionAnchors` helpers.
2. `research-queue.astro`: card `id` = the task anchor (unique, asserted at
   build — a collision fails the build, never silently dedupes); jurisdiction
   filters derive from the *rendered* (capped) rows and link each jurisdiction
   to the anchor of its first rendered card; the "How we know this" module is
   labelled with the page's name (`provenanceName` → `pageName`).
3. `HowWeKnowThis.astro` + `BaseLayout.astro`: a `pageName` prop renders a
   page-named scope sentence (batch-bound template); `BaseLayout` forwards a
   `provenanceName` prop.
4. `exports/src/exports/spine_export.py::_research_queue`: join the §33.2
   catalog (`tasks.catalog.catalog()`) on `task_type` — emit the real
   `task_id`, catalog `assignee_class`/`effort_estimate`/`geographic_scope`/
   `dispositions`; a task type outside the catalog emits `not yet classified`
   for the class/effort/scope fields and the FULL §33.4 vocabulary (any outcome
   is legal for an unclassified type) — never `contributor`, never `unknown`,
   never `[]`.
5. Frozen contract `docs/build/reports/public_surface_contracts.schema.json`:
   `task_id` added as an OPTIONAL property (additive; old exports still
   validate).
6. `/task/new/` retired: `web/src/pages/task/new/[slug].astro`,
   `web/src/lib/task.ts`, `web/tests/unit/task.test.ts` deleted;
   `TASKABLE_ABSENCES` (fixtures.ts) and `dossierTaskableAbsences` (dossier.ts)
   removed; `AbsenceHatch` renders a non-interactive named absence (the kind
   label + subject/predicate data attributes) — K11 §5.5's named-absence state
   until RQ-03 ships real `/task/<handle>/` pages (deferred to the W2 queue
   rows; recorded in the gap table, not a new DEFERRALS row — K13 §7.1 already
   owns it).
7. `ops/public_routes.toml`: `task` demoted from `required` to `top_level`
   only (real `/task/<handle>/` pages stay publishable when RQ-03 lands; a
   build that emits no `task/` no longer fails the required-set check), and
   `/task/new/` added to `[[denied]]` so the retired prefix is probed absent.
8. Copy: batch rows appended — `HW-10` (the page-named scope template),
   `RQ-01` (`not yet classified` literal, `lib/research-queue.ts`), `XC-03`
   (the same literal, `exports/spine_export.py`). `T-01` stays in the batch
   (append-only) but its page is retired — the P34.11 binding test gains a
   `RETIRED` set asserting exactly that: `T-01` recorded, never carried.
9. `tests/unit/test_p34_12_queue_truth.py`: public-source sweep — no
   "has been generated" text, no `/task/new/` links or routes, retired-page
   batch handling, and the queue page's named-scope binding.

## Boundary notes (recorded, not smoothed)

- **No production mutation, no republish.** `live_verification=false`; the
  public effect rides P34.17's republish. The denied-route tripwire rows in
  `ops/cadence.toml` are probe *config* — nothing was deployed or probed.
- **Catalog join is export-shaping only.** `_research_queue` resolves
  `task_type` through `tasks.catalog.catalog()` at export time; no detector
  run, no `research_task` writes, no spine reads beyond the existing query.
  Task types outside the catalog emit `not yet classified` + the full §33.4
  disposition vocabulary — an honest "unclassified" state, never an invented
  one. `D-R7.2-DETECTORS` stays OPEN (real hosted detector run gated).
- **`/task/<handle>/` stays publishable.** The allow-list keeps `task` as a
  top-level route (RQ-03's real task pages, deferred to the W-rows under
  K13 §7.1); only the retired `/task/new/` prefix is denied.
- **`T-01` is recorded, not carried.** The batch is append-only; the retired
  `/task/new/` row keeps its hash and gains a `RETIRED` binding in the
  P34.11 test — no history rewrite.
- **Copy rows P34.12 added (HW-10, RQ-01, XC-03) are `pending`** — an agent
  never confirms copy; the page-named scope template ships under the
  notice/template allowance the batch file already documents.
- **CI history, recorded not smoothed.** PR **#208** opened at head
